question: Was Frederica taking care of Meili? Did the two of them ever chat or something?
answer: Everyone was taking care of Meili, so of course, I think there were times when Frederica was taking care of her, too. Frederica is basically kind to everyone, so she took a suitable attitude towards Meili as well. Having said that, she was aware of having been involved in Elsa's death, so perhaps she didn't try to get that close.
